stemMd: Every approved route avoids the wetland. Some routes that avoid the wetland are too steep for trucks. No route too steep for trucks is approved for truck use. Which must be true?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Some routes avoiding the wetland are not approved for truck use.

options.label: B
options.textMd: No approved route can be used by a truck.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Some truck-approved routes cross the wetland.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Every route outside the wetland is steep.

options.label: E
options.textMd: All routes avoiding the wetland are approved.

explanationMd: The existing routes that avoid the wetland and are too steep supply witnesses. The steepness rule excludes those routes from truck approval. The conclusion does not generalize that exclusion to every route.

distractorRationale.d: Only some are stated to be steep.
distractorRationale.e: Avoidance is necessary, not sufficient, for approval.
distractorRationale.c: This is not supported by any premise.
distractorRationale.b: The steep subset need not include all approved routes.
